QuestInfo.name: Inkwell's One-Sided Love
QuestInfo.0: The chic yet reserved Inkwell seems to have someone in mind for his own affections. Just who could've stolen his heart?\n
QuestInfo.1: The lady who stole Inkwell's heart was none other than Cassandra, that haughty ball of hotness! To move her fickle heart, Inkwell wants to present her with a truly stunning present. Take the Melted Chocolate, stay logged in for 30 minutes for it to become a Heart Chocolate, and bring it to Inkwell.\n
QuestInfo.2: You made the Heart Chocolate for Inkwell. Keep helping him out so he can make his Valentine's wishes come true.\n

0.0: I never thought Valentine's Day would mean anything to me besides cheap candy, but there's someone that I just can't get out of my mind. If I tell you about this, you gotta help me, okay?

yes.0: I just can't stop thinking about Cassandra!
yes.1: Haven't you seen her, gazing into her crystal ball with that coy grin of hers...not to mention her mysterious allure and incredible fashion sense. I just know that if I don't confess my feelings to her now, I'll regret it all year. Can you help me give her something that will touch her heart? If you hold onto this Melted Chocolate for 30 minutes, it will congeal into a Heart Chocolate. Bring that to me, okay?

no.0: Well...all right. I guess I can do it myself...

1.0: Do you have the Heart Chocolate yet? Love like mine can't wait forever!

yes.0: This is great, but to make the gift as big as I want, I'm going to need more chocolate. Bring me as much as you can, all right?

item.0: I need that chocolate as soon as possible. My heart is bursting here!
